study: Corn-stover to DMCO jet fuel: LCA + TEA (Sustainable Energy Fuels 2024)
their_var: catalyst recovery loading / make-up rate (LCA scenario)
their_baseline: base case 1 g catalyst loss per kg DMCO
their_range: best 0.1 g/kg DMCO (low loss), worst 5 g/kg DMCO (high loss), base 1 g/kg DMCO; total GHG 7.2->16.3 gCO2e/MJ for high make-up
range_justification: Best/worst/base catalyst recovery-loading sensitivities based on Dros et al. (2015) (ref 67); catalyst make-up varied per GREET 2022 (ref 71)
quote: Based on Dros et al.(2015) the following best, worst and base case sensitivities were considered for the catalyst recovery loading: (1) Best case: low catalyst loss 0.1 g per kg DMCO. (2) Worst case: high catalyst loss 5 g per kg DMCO. (3) Base case: 1 g per kg DMCO.
